children: Disney said its streaming platform will livestream the Super Bowl in 2027.
All Disney+ subscribers in the U.S. will be able to stream the traditional game presentation airing on ESPN and ABC, as well as the Spanish-language telecast on ESPN Deportes.
The Super Bowl was broadcast on NBC, Telemundo and Peacock in 2026.
Outside the U.S., Disney+ will stream the Super Bowl in more than 55 international markets.

In addition to the Super Bowl, Disney+ will stream two Monday Night Football games during the regular season in the lead-up to the final game. The first regular-season game on Disney+ will be the Dallas Cowboys versus the Philadelphia Eagles on Oct. 26.
Both regular-season games will continue to air as scheduled on ESPN and ABC, as well as ESPN Deportes, Disney said.
